linkedin: Remote hiring managers read applications on a screen, between meetings, often in a second language. To stand out, make your application easy to scan and clearly written for the role. Open with the exact job title and where you saw it, then explain how your recent work fits the team's work in one sentence. Show proof of async work experience by mentioning a project with written updates or a time zone gap you handled well. Also, match the job post's words, keep your CV short and current, and follow up once politely if you hear nothing after a week. Learn how to increase your chances of getting hired: https://lokerdollar.com
